description: Canonical XML 1.0 (inclusive, no comments) of the generated 1 and 10 MB parse inputs: go-xml (xdm parse + c14n.Write) against xmllint --c14n. The check is not byte-exact: xmllint --c14n keeps comments and the go-xml helper writes C14N without comments (Inclusive10), so both outputs are re-canonicalised (xml-c14n) before comparing, and xmllint's output is about 2% larger. The cold process is the same as the parse workload's (benchrun -helper go-xml, xmllint --c14n); warm adds the canonical serialisation to a null sink on top of the parse. The 100 MB input is left out: it exceeds xdm's default 64 MiB MaxBytes, which the helper does not raise.
